hypothesis: Extending a HYPE breakout position beyond the eight-hour soft deadline only while causal multi-timeframe structure remains directionally supported may capture continuation without indiscriminately extending mixed or opposed positions.
decision: Retain the current eight-hour soft deadline, continuously re-evaluated direction-support threshold, original venue stop, and twenty-four-hour hard deadline. Do not loosen the support threshold, extend mixed or opposed contexts, widen the hard deadline, or add an early profit lock from this sample.
falsifier: Retire or revise the extension if resolved live extension decisions repeatedly produce lower net PnL than their causal soft-boundary references after fees, funding, and slippage, or if additional supported timer exits show negative post-boundary continuation or repeated protective-stop hits.
limitations: Only one historical timer exit met the current direction-support extension rule.
Post-boundary incremental PnL uses completed candles and the retained stop but excludes changed funding, fees, and executable exit slippage.
Historical timer exits came from mixed strategy profiles and do not reproduce the current continuously re-evaluated policy end to end.
The current open HYPE lifecycle has not reached its soft deadline and is excluded from resolved outcomes.
This retention decision is bounded canary evidence, not proof of a durable exit edge.
